subject.title: System prompt: add guidance for spawning background sub-agents

question: Should this stale maintainer prompt-policy PR be rebased and consolidated into the current sub-agent guidance surfaces, or paused because current main already covers the intended delegation behavior?
rationale: The remaining choice is prompt-policy direction across model-facing guidance and nested sub-agent semantics, and the PR is protected by a maintainer label.

options.title: Rebase And Consolidate Prompt Policy
options.body: Resolve conflicts and fold any useful examples into the current Tooling, Messaging, tool-description, or delegation-mode guidance so there is one availability- and depth-aware policy source.

options.title: Change Nested Policy Coherently
options.body: If maintainers want to forbid nested sub-agents, update runtime policy, config schema/help, docs, and tests in the same change.

options.title: Pause Or Close As Covered
options.body: If current main's shipped guidance is enough, leave the protected branch paused or close it through explicit maintainer action.
